title: Text and reading check sheet
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: Reading dialogues: a school event; getting to know each other; the heater
source: Written for arabic/y6 lesson 8 (Text and reading check sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 8: Reading text: the heater; reading check. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

arabic.text: الجَوُّ بَارِدٌ فِي الشِّتَاءِ. فِي غُرْفَةِ الجُلُوسِ مِدْفَأَةٌ. تُشْعِلُ أُمِّي المِدْفَأَةَ فِي المَسَاءِ. نَجْلِسُ قُرْبَ المِدْفَأَةِ وَنَقْرَأُ. قَالَ أَبِي: لَا تَلْمِسُوا المِدْفَأَةَ، هِيَ حَارَّةٌ جِدًّا! نُطْفِئُ المِدْفَأَةَ قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ.
arabic.ref: Our own text for 'the heater' (Kitabi version: CHECK IN KITABI)

panels.title: Reading check: how to answer
points: Find the line in the text
Answer in a short Arabic phrase

keywords.def: we turn off, we put out

questions.a: فِي غُرْفَةِ الجُلُوسِ (in the living room)

questions.q: Why must they not touch it?
questions.a: هِيَ حَارَّةٌ جِدًّا (it is very hot)

questions.q: Core (reading check, portal response box or paper): 1) مَتَى تُشْعِلُ الأُمُّ المِدْفَأَةَ؟ 2) مَاذَا تَفْعَلُ الأُسْرَةُ قُرْبَ المِدْفَأَةِ؟ 3) Match: بَارِد، حَارّ، مُسَابَقَة، هِوَايَة with cold, hot, competition, hobby. 4) In the school event dialogue, which day is the competition?
questions.a: 1) فِي المَسَاءِ 2) تَجْلِسُ وَتَقْرَأُ (they sit and read) 3) بَارِد cold; حَارّ hot; مُسَابَقَة competition; هِوَايَة hobby 4) يَوْمَ الخَمِيسِ

questions.q: Extend: Write the father's safety rule in Arabic and in English.
questions.a: لَا تَلْمِسُوا المِدْفَأَةَ، هِيَ حَارَّةٌ جِدًّا. Do not touch the heater, it is very hot.

questions.q: Stretch: Write one more safety rule with لَا, e.g. لَا تَتْرُكُوا ... (do not leave ...).
questions.a: For example: لَا تَتْرُكُوا المِدْفَأَةَ مُشْتَعِلَةً فِي اللَّيْلِ.

questions.q: When does the family turn off the heater?
questions.a: B) قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ (before sleeping). The text says نُطْفِئُ المِدْفَأَةَ قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ.

questions.q: What is المِدْفَأَة? A) the heater B) the window C) the kitchen
Big question: what did you do to show you understood the text?
questions.a: Found the question word, found the line, answered in Arabic.
